checks: No page horizontal overflow after long-block-ID layout repair
PNG image import, Lab00 dithering and preview
Slope build with lossless compression and glass bridges
Material count and valid Litematica download (258x187x194,63414 blocks)
IndexedDB cache save/restore and count/byte statistics
Cache clear preserves image, invalidates result and export recomputes
Four map dat files downloaded in valid ZIP and independently decoded
Palette tool without image returns 180 allowed colors
Test-blocklist tool exports independently decoded native structure
Packaged dist subdirectory initializes all local resources
Custom Quark ZIP imports 43 blocks and shows native 16x16 PNG icon on desktop

limitations: Node benchmark is not browser performance
No VisualCraft or separate desktop utilities

checks: Public-source allowlist excludes credentials and generated directories
Configured build directory excluded from source archive
Output cleanup preserves sources and refuses unsafe targets
Already isolated pages start directly without registering a Service Worker
A successful isolated reload starts the application; failed isolation does not reload in a loop
Concurrent preparation cannot trigger a second automatic reload
Existing foreign Service Workers and denied storage are preserved and diagnosed
Interception is restricted to the same origin and the intersection of registration scope and script directory
Cross-origin, API, Range, redirect, opaque, partial and not-modified responses are not rewritten
Network failures propagate without a cache or project-data fallback
